inverse-function.def: For a one-to-one function $f$, the function $f^{-1}$ that undoes it: $f^{-1}(b) = a$ exactly when $f(a) = b$. Its graph is the reflection of the graph of $f$ across $y = x$. A function is one-to-one when no two inputs share an output.

inverse-trig.def: $\arcsin x$, $\arccos x$ and $\arctan x$ (also written $\sin^{-1} x$, ...) give the angle with a given sine, cosine or tangent, from a restricted range: $\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ for arcsine, $[0, \pi]$ for arccosine, $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$ for arctangent.
